$comment: Third-party skills and where they come from. NONE is stored in this repository: the 26 that used to sit under vendor/ now live in optional pack repositories, specified by packs/ and attached per Project. This file records what is NOT packaged, plus the multi-agent install behaviour worth knowing about.

orca-cli.reason: DROPPED from the toolkit, on evidence from the tree rather than from a README. Its SKILL.md is a 46-line discovery stub whose entire body resolves an `orca` executable and then asks it for the real guide, so without the binary there is no degraded mode -- there is nothing. No orca, orca-ide or orca-dev was on PATH and ORCA_CLI_COMMAND was unset in the environment where it would most often load. Nothing in this repository depended on it. At 642 description characters it was the second most expensive description of the 27, and it is the only one with no upstream plugin: stablyai/orca ships no .claude-plugin at all.
orca-cli.stillWorksWhere: A machine with Orca installed. That is a local-install concern; link it from an Orca checkout if you want it there.
orca-cli.toReinstate: add a packs/orca.json with the pin above and build it like any other pack

find-skills.reason: Present in ~/.agents/skills but NOT linked into ~/.claude/skills, so it is not available to Claude Code locally either. Vendoring it would add a capability rather than port one. Add a pack spec under packs/ if that changes.

ui-ux-pro-max.reason: A real directory in ~/.claude/skills duplicating what the ui-ux-pro-max plugin ships. Vendoring it would fork a plugin's own content for no gain. LOCAL DELIVERY IS REVIEWED, NOT VERIFIED: profile/plugins.json records installedLocally 2.5.0, which is installation, not skill delivery, and no test here invokes the skill through the plugin. That is the load-bearing half of this decision and it carries no measurement. IN CLOUD, on 2026-09-20, in Anthropic's hosted environment, a fresh session with this plugin declared in .claude/settings.json installed zero plugins (docs/host-integration.md, profile/plugins.json cloudObservation). This field previously said the plugin was declared in .claude/settings.json and installs in cloud; neither half was true by then -- the keys had moved to profile/plugins.json and the measurement had already been taken. Scope: that environment, that date. It is not a claim about cloud sessions generally; profile/plugins.json claimTiers marks the universal version NOT ESTABLISHED. Project settings -> Plugins is the documented route for a cloud project that wants it; that route is DOCUMENTED, NOT MEASURED here.

ecc skills (181).reason: Delivered by the ecc plugin locally, which is why they are not packaged. LOCAL DELIVERY IS REVIEWED, NOT VERIFIED, on the same footing as ui-ux-pro-max above: profile/plugins.json records installedLocally 1.10.0, which is installation rather than skill delivery. IN CLOUD, on 2026-09-20, in Anthropic's hosted environment, ecc@ecc was measured NOT INSTALLED and its marketplace never registered (docs/host-integration.md, profile/plugins.json cloudObservation). This field previously said the plugin is declared in .claude/settings.json; it is not, and the keys are in profile/plugins.json. Scope: that environment, that date, not cloud sessions generally. Project settings -> Plugins is the documented route, DOCUMENTED and not measured here.

externalAudit.$comment: Provenance for the Phase 2 external-source audit, so it is not repeated. The full report is a working document outside this repository; only what a future reader needs in order NOT to re-audit is kept here. HEADLINE: ten repositories, roughly 1,410 skill-shaped files, ZERO new canonical-core candidates and nothing proposed for text reuse. Five clauses belonged inside existing skills. Three were run-level rules: two landed as orchestration principles O29 and O30, and the third -- that concurrent reviews of one artifact stay separately attributable -- landed in docs/concepts/independence.md without an O-number, with a pointer to it from O13. This record is provenance for later external-capability work, not a decision to import anything.
externalAudit.method: Every repository read from its own cloned tree, never from a README or a web page: git clone --depth 1 --filter=tree:0, then git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD, then SKILL.md bodies read in full. Plain HTTPS to github.com and codeload.github.com are proxy-denied in this environment, so no summary-fetching route existed.
externalAudit.refCaveat: auditedRef is what the audit recorded at the time. Where refIsCompleteSha is false the ref is an abbreviated commit id, and where auditedRef is null the audit recorded no commit id at all -- it read that repository at its HEAD on the audit date. A null is NOT a licence to substitute today's HEAD: today's HEAD is a different claim about a different tree. Re-resolve and record a full sha before relying on any of these for a build. OBSERVED 2026-09-22 in this environment: github.com refused a direct `git fetch origin <abbreviated-sha>` for each abbreviated ref tried, so an abbreviated ref could not be resolved that way. One route that did work here was `git clone --filter=blob:none` of the repository followed by `git rev-parse <abbrev>^{commit}`; other recovery routes were not tried and nothing here establishes that this is the only one. auditedRefFull below carries the resolved 40-character sha wherever one was established, and says how.
externalAudit.categories: The six buckets the audit placed every item into: canonical-core candidate; extension of an existing canonical skill; optional domain pack; workflow or orchestration idea; host or tooling capability; redundant or reject.

result.carryNote: CORRECTED AND RENAMED 2026-09-22. The key was deliversSkillsByClaudeSkillsEntries, which asserted delivery; nothing here measures delivery. What is measured is that a repository CARRIES .claude/skills/ entries. The value read 0 with the note "None of the ten carries .claude/skills/ entries; all deliver by plugin manifest". Both halves were wrong for two of the ten, and the audit itself says so: rtk-ai/rtk carries a real .claude/skills/ directory of 12 SKILL.md files (audit 3.10) and shanraisshan/claude-code-best-practice carries one holding 7 SKILL.md (audit 3.7, which adds "No plugin manifest anywhere"). ALL TEN WERE RE-MEASURED 2026-09-22, each at its own auditedRefFull, counting paths under .claude/skills/: rtk 15 at 0c279f54e0cee3270b65882ca9bc97f7feba5b58 and shanraisshan 9 at 5372d67bc098b25c4a4c875bc20d57e3c375ba2b, and ZERO at each of the other seven resolved refs -- superpowers, mattpocock, mukul975, K-Dense, multica-ai, claude-mem and oh-my-claudecode. The two positives are therefore a transcription error in this record and not upstream drift, and the value 2 rests on ten measurements rather than on two plus eight carried zeros. THE TENTH, affaan-m/ECC, IS THE EXCEPTION: it has no audited ref, so its zero was measured at today's HEAD bf70150eb2df8070024e5bdf08e4aa08959e2735 and says nothing about the tree the audit read. Counting note: shanraisshan's 9 is a PATH count under .claude/skills/ (7 SKILL.md plus two reference files); the repository holds 9 SKILL.md in total, the other 2 being under agent-teams/.claude/skills/. Both positives carry the content as REAL DIRECTORIES, not symlinks into a skills/ tree. WHETHER ATTACHING EITHER WOULD DELIVER THOSE SKILLS IS NOT MEASURED -- neither has been attached to a Project, and this project's own scar is that a marketplace was reachable and the plugin still did not install. Containing skill-shaped markdown, carrying the entries, and delivering skills are three different claims. The narrower claim the pack tier rests on is untouched and remains VERIFIED: cloudflare/skills, Leonxlnx/taste-skill and stablyai/orca carry zero such entries (packs/README.md, "The .claude/skills/ entries are load-bearing", 2026-09-20).

phase2bClassification.$comment: Phase 2B asked one question of each of the ten: what is its intended relationship to this toolkit. Thrasos named the five buckets; each repository's answer is on it above as phase2bRelationship. THE RESULT IS THAT NO REPOSITORY OF THE TEN BECOMES A PACK and no content is taken from any of them; what Phase 2B changed is this record, not the toolkit.
phase2bClassification.decidedBy: Thrasos, who named the five buckets and accepted C1-C10 of the Phase 2B plan
phase2bClassification.terminalStateNote: COMPLETED, not EXHAUSTED, on his decision of 2026-09-22. The phase's question was asked of all ten and answered for all ten; the answer is that none of them earns a new pack or a capability addition. EXHAUSTED would mean the evidence or the limits did not suffice to answer, and that is not what happened here.
phase2bClassification.bucketRule: The buckets are NOT disjoint -- several repositories satisfy the plain wording of two -- so they are applied as an ordered procedure, first match winning, and every placement above is derivable from it. (1) Is the repository's value to this toolkit a TOOL THAT RUNS -- a binary, a database, an MCP server, a hook -- rather than text that is read? Then LOCAL_PROFILE_CAPABILITY, whatever else is also true of it. (2) Otherwise, did anything from it land in the canonical layer in Phase 2A? Then IDEAS_ALREADY_ABSORBED. (3) Otherwise, does any record in this repository still cite it -- laterCandidateRecorded, its alsoDeferred list, or a roadmap item? Then REFERENCE_ONLY. (4) Otherwise REJECT. OPTIONAL_PACK is not a step in that order: it is a disposition of CONTENT, considered for every repository and granted to none of the ten, with the reason on each row that reached the question.
phase2bClassification.bucketRuleNotes: Two consequences worth stating rather than leaving to be rediscovered. FIRST, step 1 is why superpowers is IDEAS_ALREADY_ABSORBED while claude-mem is LOCAL_PROFILE_CAPABILITY although both are installed plugins with a clause that landed: superpowers' value here was its procedural text, claude-mem's is a database and a server. SECOND, a citation from alsoDeferred counts at step 3 exactly as one from laterCandidateRecorded does -- both are recorded-not-approved -- which is why mattpocock is REFERENCE_ONLY on two citations and mukul975, multica-ai and shanraisshan are REJECT on none. An earlier draft of this rule tried to separate the two lists by calling one live and the other not; it could not, and that reading is withdrawn.

buckets.REFERENCE_ONLY: nothing from it landed, but a record here still cites it; nothing is copied
buckets.LOCAL_PROFILE_CAPABILITY: its value is a tool that runs on a machine; belongs to profile/ or local/, and check.py's host invariant forbids the canonical layer from naming it
buckets.OPTIONAL_PACK: a spec under packs/ and a built pack repository, attached per Project
buckets.IDEAS_ALREADY_ABSORBED: something from it landed in the canonical layer in Phase 2A
buckets.REJECT: nothing from it landed and no record here cites it; the row exists so nobody re-audits it
